descriptions.startRain: Starts rain. Intensity is optional and ranges from 1 to 100.
descriptions.startStorm: Starts a storm. Duration is optional and measured in game hours.
descriptions.events: Targets a randomly selected online player with the chosen event.
descriptions.reloadOptions: Reloads the server options from disk.
descriptions.reloadLua: Reloads the first loaded Lua file whose path ends with the entered value.
descriptions.reloadAllLua: Reloads all currently loaded Lua files.

dialogs.stopDescription: This saves the world, disconnects all players, and stops the server.

success.messageSent: Message sent to all online players.
success.helicopter: Helicopter event triggered for a random online player.
success.gunshot: Gunshot triggered near a random online player.
